activities.title: Guided horse ride through rice fields to the beach
activities.overview: A guided ride out along the rice fields, village roads and down to the beach. Salty Cowboy's grooms come with you the whole way, on foot.

goodToKnow.label: Group size
goodToKnow.value: Up to 5 riders, privately guided

goodToKnow.label: Weight
goodToKnow.value: Weight limit 70kg. Nothing personal, it's to protect our horses' backs.

goodToKnow.label: Riding experience
goodToKnow.value: None needed. If you've never ridden or are a beginner, staff lead your horse on a lead rope for the whole ride. Intermediate and advanced riders can trot and canter in moderation, with no galloping, and your guide assesses you when you reach the beach.

included: Staff guiding on foot the whole way
Photos taken on your phone by our team

images.alt: Horse and rider on the beach with rice fields behind, Salty Cowboy Bali

activities.cardDesc: A relaxed guided ride along the beach and through rice fields.

activities.title: Beach and rice field photoshoot with a groomed horse
activities.overview: A static shoot for fashion, pre-wedding or personal sessions, along a 900m route through the rice fields to the beach. Time starts when you leave the stables. Out of respect for local culture, please no swimwear. Share your outfit plans with Simone beforehand.

goodToKnow.label: Group size
goodToKnow.value: One person per horse

goodToKnow.label: Format
goodToKnow.value: Static photoshoot, not riding except walking. Shooting time starts when you leave the stables and ends when you're back.

goodToKnow.label: Helmets
goodToKnow.value: Required on the walk to and from the beach

goodToKnow.label: Clothing
goodToKnow.value: No swimwear or bikinis, out of respect for local culture

goodToKnow.label: Before your shoot
goodToKnow.value: Share your shoot purpose, brand or client, and outfit plans with Salty Cowboy beforehand

included: Staff to help and assist you
The 900m walk through the village and along the rice fields to the beach

activities.title: Leadership and trust clinic with horses, for groups
activities.overview: A hands-on session in leadership, communication and trust, taught through the horse. Working in the arena, your group learns to read body language, hold presence and earn cooperation without force, the same skills you'd use in any team setting. Popular with women's groups, business teams, and friend groups that love horses.

goodToKnow.label: Group size
goodToKnow.value: 3 to 6 people, flat price per session, not per person

goodToKnow.label: Experience
goodToKnow.value: No riding experience needed

activities.title: 3-day Horse Whisperer course
activities.basis: for the full course, up to 2 people
activities.overview: A 3-day, 10-hour course spread over Monday, Tuesday and Thursday. Two sessions build the basics, then a closing session brings it together, including 2 hours of grooming or another related activity. Open to all levels, no experience needed. This course is for two people, so bring a friend.

goodToKnow.label: Group size
goodToKnow.value: Max 2 people, one course booking per week

goodToKnow.label: Minimum age
goodToKnow.value: 8 and over

goodToKnow.label: Experience
goodToKnow.value: All levels

included: 2 hours of grooming or another related activity
notIncluded: Riding. This course is groundwork, not ridden work
